title: I used Claude to get GTA 2 running in a browser
author: Thisiaphr0
selftext:
GTA 2, in a browser tab. I used Claude Code to help port it, then added widescreen, a map with waypoints and a calmer camera that doesn't keep zooming in and out while you drive.



Huge credit to CriminalRETeam's gta2\_re, the community decompilation this builds on. My work is the browser port and the additions around it.



The engine is C++ compiled to WebAssembly with Emscripten. I worked with Claude on the browser integration: replacing the Windows graphics, audio and input layers with WebGL, Web Audio and browser controls, plus keeping saves locally in the browser.



One interesting snag: some original game data tables were missing from the decompilation. Getting it running involved recovering those from the original executable, including things as specific as truck hitch offsets and horn rhythms.



The source, build notes and playable demo link are on GitHub:

[https://github.com/M1sterMo/gta2-browser](https://github.com/M1sterMo/gta2-browser)



It's free to try. First launch fetches about 346 MB of game data, so give it a moment. This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Rockstar or Take-Two.



What would you change about the original GTA 2?
